thread:
Alex K: Heads-up — since the kernel-selection tweak landed yesterday we're seeing p99 spikes under high concurrency on staging. Not obvious from p50/p95.
Maria G: saw that too. I pulled a couple flamegraphs, looks like KV cache refill is spiking CPU on the host and causing RT stalls. link: https://perf.internal/flame/1769123 (perm is open for eng-runtime)
Samir: I think it's correlated with microbatch growth. The batching heuristic now pushes microbatch_size=16 for tokens>64; previously we stayed at 8. More requests get merged into larger microbatches which increases KV footprint per batch.
Jin: yes — larger microbatches amplify KV cache pressure. Evictions/sec jumped ~3x in the tail windows from my quick scrape. Perf Bot posted an alert: "regression: p99 latency +220% in staging (kernel-select-v3)"
Perf Bot: [alert] metric: response.p99, window: 10m, baseline: 120ms -> current: 390ms, affected: /v1/generate on rtx-dedicated-2
Tera: any quick repro for me to run locally? I can spin up a 20-concurrency loadtest.
Alex K: repro steps I used:
```
ab -n 20000 -c 20 -T 'application/json' -p small_payload.json https://staging.redwood/api/generate
```
payload: ~120 tokens typical.
Maria G: attaching the CPU timeline snippet and a log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-10T14:21:03Z] kv_cache: eviction=124 ops=540 hit_rate=0.62
[2026-03-10T14:21:04Z] batcher: microbatch.size=16 merged=7 latency_ms=175
[2026-03-10T14:21:04Z] kernel: selected=fused_attn_v2
[2026-03-10T14:21:04Z] latency: p99=412ms p95=78ms p50=32ms
```
Samir: interesting that kernel= fused_attn_v2 — that kernel is faster per-token but is more memory-hungry for KV and alloc pattern triggers bigger transient allocations when microbatch is larger. That plus eviction churn explains the tail.
Jin: two levers here: reduce microbatch target or change cache admission/eviction policy (LRU -> segmented LRU or admission window). Both have tradeoffs.
Tera: what about temporarily forcing kernel-selection to older kernel for canary? degrade throughput slightly but maybe flatten tail.
Alex K: we can toggle kernel via model_config: 
```
{"kernel_policy": "conservative", "microbatch_max": 12}
```
I tried a quick run with microbatch_max=12 and p99 dropped to ~170ms but throughput dropped ~9%.
Maria G: I ran profiling with microbatch_max=12 and cache_capacity set to 75% (was 90%). Evictions/sec fell 60% and p99 improved. So promising.
Samir: longer term: batching heuristic should consider estimated KV cost (seq_len * microbatch_size) when deciding merges. We currently only use token count and latency target. Add a KV pressure signal.
Jin: agreed. For immediate mitigation I propose:
- Backfill: revert kernel-select-v3 on staging only (canary)
- Reduce microbatch_max to 12 for low-latency tier
- Enable eviction backoff: when evictions/sec > threshold, pause merges for 200ms
That should get us under SLO while we implement smarter heuristic.
Perf Bot: [note] rollback plan created: ops-ticket #9876, canary to staging at 15:30 UTC
Tera: I'll run the canary and capture p50/p95/p99, kv_hits, evictions/sec, GPU util. Running now and will post results in ~30m.
Alex K: thanks. Samir can you draft the heuristic change? Something like:
```
if estimated_kv_cost > kv_threshold: reduce_merge_depth()
else: normal_merge()
```
We should simulate with our loadmodel harness.
Samir: on it. I'll add a simulation test in the batcher repo and run against recorded traces from prod.
Maria G: also I'll produce flamegraphs for both kernels and a diff of allocation hotspots. That should help justify perf-vs-cost tradeoffs to PMs.
Jin: one more note — we saw that p95 barely moves, p99 is the problem. So SLO adjustment isn't the fix; need structural change to reduce tail.
Alex K: agreed. If the canary shows stable p99 with the rollback + microbatch cap, we'll roll to prod minimal-impact path. Otherwise we'll need to accept 10% throughput hit for tail safety.
Tera: first canary run: p50=34ms p95=86ms p99=162ms, evictions/sec=18 (vs 50 before), kv_hit=0.81, gpu_util=72% :thumbsup:
Maria G: nice. please save flamegraphs and I'll annotate.
Samir: created draft PR with KV-aware merge heuristics, tests added. link: https://code.redwood/pr/12345
Alex K: action items: Tera - run extended canary for 2h and post metrics; Maria - flamegraphs + allocation diff; Samir - land small heuristic change behind flag and run sim; Jin - prepare rollback + ops steps for prod. I'll coordinate with SRE for timing.
Tera: running extended now. will update. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria G: thanks all. let's reconvene in #eng-runtime in 2h or earlier if alerts pop. :calendar:
